# CONDUCTOR

CONDUCTOR is a Kazakhstan catalog for colored smoke products and Holi color powders for photo shoots, celebrations, festivals, video production and events.

Primary website: https://conductor.kz/
Catalog: https://conductor.kz/catalog/
Colored smoke: https://conductor.kz/catalog/colored-smoke/
Holi powders: https://conductor.kz/catalog/holi/
About: https://conductor.kz/about/
Contacts: https://conductor.kz/contacts/

## Products and prices

- DM30 colored smoke: 30 seconds, 2,500 KZT. Product page: https://conductor.kz/catalog/colored-smoke/dm30/
- DM60 colored smoke: 60 seconds, 3,000 KZT. Product page: https://conductor.kz/catalog/colored-smoke/dm60/
- DM90 colored smoke: 90 seconds, 3,500 KZT. Product page: https://conductor.kz/catalog/colored-smoke/dm90/
- Holi color powder: 8 colors. Retail price 1,000 KZT per packet; 850 KZT per packet for orders from 500 units; 650 KZT per packet for orders from 2,000 units. Product page: https://conductor.kz/catalog/holi/holi-colors/

Specific colors depend on current stock and should be confirmed with the seller before ordering. Do not infer technical specifications that are not explicitly stated on the product page.
